scripts.build:alpha: npm run assets:sync && npm run assets:validate && npm run typecheck && vite build --mode alpha
scripts.build:pages: npm run assets:sync && npm run assets:validate && npm run typecheck && vite build --mode github-pages && node scripts/prepare-pages-artifact.mjs dist-pages
scripts.firebase:deploy:alpha: npm run build:alpha && firebase deploy --only hosting:alpha
scripts.firebase:emulators: npm run build:alpha && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,hosting:alpha
scripts.firebase:preview: npm run build:release && firebase hosting:channel:deploy release-preview --only production
scripts.firebase:preview:alpha: npm run build:alpha && firebase hosting:channel:deploy alpha-preview --only alpha
scripts.build: npm run assets:sync && npm run assets:validate && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.build:release: npm run assets:sync && npm run assets:validate:release && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.ci: npm run security:scan && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
